added: The first public release, under its name: METEOR V1.
Capture with an editor, screen recording, a radial menu, a command bar and a desktop companion.
A voice assistant (new, off by default, English only).
changed: Settings, data and saved keys of the code-named build are copied over at the first start; the old install is left as it is.
Agents are connected again from Settings, with the usual diff and confirmation.

added: Apps: the updates winget can install, a package search, these release notes and a way to send feedback.
Music with lyrics, volume and brightness levels, the battery and a clipboard history in the island.
Timers, downloads, a calendar with reminders, the weather and a shelf for files.
changed: One dark look across the island, its windows and the settings.
Every feature can be turned off, and a feature that is off loads nothing.
